questions: Should the function consider character frequencies (counts) or only presence/absence of characters?
Does the function need to handle empty strings, and if so, are two empty strings considered to have the same characters?
Are non-alphabetic characters (digits, punctuation, whitespace) allowed, and if so, are they compared normally?
Should the function return True if both strings contain the same set of characters but one contains duplicates the other lacks?
